text:
evan: :rotating_light: paging oncall — sudden KV cache runaway and continuous-batch amplification observed across multiple clusters (qwen + llama-longseq), lots of 5xx and tail latency spikes
incident-bot: Incident INC-2001 opened by evan • severity=P1 • notify: @oncall @eng-runtime @eng-sre
jia: seeing kv_total_size jump on shard-21-us; correlated with bursty mixed MQA/GQA requests to long-prefix routes
kelsey: traces show continuous_batch increasing active prefixes; per-key concurrent inflight up ~8x after recent tuning change
sam: emergency options: 1) global cap 2) targeted prune 3) fallback routing to compact model 4) full cont-batch disable
ops-lead: prefer minimal-impact path: set conservative global cap and target prunes for hot shards
kelsey: applying cap=48 to cont-batch at scale
```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/configs \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" \
  -d '{"key":"continuous_batch_global_cap","value":48}'
```
deploy-bot: config rolled out to qwen-cluster-3 & llama-longseq-pool by kelsey — rollout id r-2001a
jia: cap slowed growth but eviction thrash persists on shard-21-us and shard-09-eu — KV hotspots remain
maria (support): two customers (edge-ai, realtimex) report higher latency and occasional 502s; CS loop started
sam: starting targeted prune on shard-21-us with window=2700s; note compaction may be CPU heavy
```
# prune
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/kv/prune \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPSTOKEN" \
  -d '{"shard":"shard-21-us","older_than_sec":2700}'
```

kelsey: kicked prune job; compaction queued with low-priority flag
ops-lead: add routing fallback for tenants hitting /chat/longseq to qwen-compact variant
sam: adding routing rule (canary) for tenant=realtimex -> model=qwen-4q8-compact
deploy-bot: routing rule added by sam — route=/chat/longseq tenant=realtimex -> qwen-4q8-compact
jia: after prune + cap + routing change: p95 latency qwen-cluster-3 down from 2.4s -> 0.85s, 5xx reduction ~78%
evan: llama-longseq still showing sticky tail — probable cause: extremely long sequence KVs pinned despite prune window
kelsey: enabling prefix compaction on llama-longseq with cpu-throttle; will monitor OOMs
sam: started compaction on shard-09-eu; watch for host pressure
oncall-bot: handoff: evan -> kelsey at 1977043400 — active mitigations documented
jia: rolling an admission control patch: if kv_entry_bytes > 40MB then reject continuous_batch for that key and fallback to single-request
kelsey: deployed admission control; telemetry will emit cont_batch_rejects metric
maria (support): CS update: realtimex reduced concurrency, reports noticeable improvement; edge-ai on slower cadence but improving
ops-lead: created alert: kv_shard_size > 1GB for >4m -> page eng-sre
sam: noticed one compaction worker OOM'd; drained host and rescheduled, minimal impact
evan: timeline summary:
- 1977043210 incident opened INC-2001
- 1977043255 applied continuous_batch cap=48
- 1977043330 started prune on shard-21-us (window=2700s)
- 1977043390 added routing fallback for realtimex -> qwen-4q8-compact
- 1977043420 enabled prefix compaction (throttled) on llama-longseq
- 1977043505 deployed kv-entry-size admission control
kelsey: proposed long-term fixes: per-model cont-batch caps, KV-size admission thresholds, automated off-peak prune job, and improved longseq routing policies
sam: opening INFRA ticket to implement per-model caps and kv-based admission control
ops-lead: CS to finish customer comms and postmortem; SRE to publish mitigations and lessons
incident-bot: Incident INC-2001 closed for active paging at 1977043580 — monitoring continues
maria (support): will follow up with affected customers and link to postmortem once ready
evan: root cause (draft): concurrent changes increasing cont-batch plus mixed MQA/GQA long-prefix reuse led to runaway KV growth and eviction thrash on certain shards; mitigations stabilized cluster
kelsey: recommend adding a mixed-traffic canary to catch similar regressions in future
sam: noted — adding to infra test plan
